external_sources.title: Contextual Linear Activation Steering of Language Models
external_sources.finding_scope: Across eleven steering benchmarks and four model families, context-dependent steering strength outperformed fixed-strength linear steering in the reported experiments.
external_sources.project_effect: Supports PREREGISTERED_CONTEXT_CONDITIONING: positive J-Space control candidates must be indexed by context/function/intervention scope rather than promoted as one global fixed vector from one context. METHOD_INPUT_ONLY; no Qwen3.5-0.8B causal credit.

external_sources.title: Causal Interventions on Continuous Variables: A Case Study on Verb Bias in Steering Vectors for In-Context Learning
external_sources.finding_scope: The reported intervention causally shifted downstream structural preference for a graded feature, while other encoded error-signal aspects were observed but not causally used in downstream production.
external_sources.project_effect: Strengthens the project distinction DECODED_OR_ENCODED != CAUSALLY_USED. J-Space evaluation must separate READ/DECODE evidence from controlled downstream use and behavioral mediation. METHOD_INPUT_ONLY.

external_sources.title: Surgical Activation Steering via Generative Causal Mediation
external_sources.finding_scope: The paper reports component selection by generative causal mediation and stronger steering than correlational probe baselines on its evaluated tasks/models.
external_sources.project_effect: Supports causal mediation/lesion/patch/rescue selection as stronger promotion evidence than probe accuracy alone. It does not establish the same mechanism in Qwen3.5-0.8B.
